description: This PHP source file defines the class VTWorkflowTemplateManager, which manages workflow templates within the vtiger CRM system. It provides functionalities to create, retrieve, save, delete, and serialize workflow templates, as well as generate workflows from templates and export/import templates as JSON strings.

classes.name: VTWorkflowTemplateManager
classes.description: A manager class for handling workflow templates, including CRUD operations and serialization.

methods.name: newTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new workflow template instance based on a workflow object without saving it.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow template by ID from the database.

methods.name: createWorkflow
methods.description: Creates a workflow object from a template.

methods.name: getTemplatesForModule
methods.description: Fetches all templates associated with a specific module.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Saves or updates a workflow template in the database.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a workflow template by ID.

methods.name: dumpAllTemplates
methods.description: Exports all templates as a JSON string for backup or transfer.

methods.name: loadTemplates
methods.description: Loads templates from a JSON string, importing and creating workflows accordingly.

classes.name: VTWorkflowTemplate
classes.description: Data class representing a workflow template, likely contains properties such as id, title, moduleName, and template.
